description: This source file defines classes and extension methods for configuring Cassandra clustering in Orleans. It includes options classes for Cassandra settings and extension methods for integrating Cassandra clustering into Orleans client and silo builders.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Cassandra clustering, including retry delay, TTL usage, and methods for configuring the Cassandra client session.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Sets up the Cassandra session configuration using a delegate or connection string.

methods.name: UseCassandraClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to add Cassandra clustering support to Orleans client and silo builders with various configuration options.
